title: Gap Analysis Report - Energy Grid System

discrepancies.title: Wrong Database Type: MongoDB instead of Relational Database
discrepancies.description: Implementation uses MongoDB (NoSQL) but design specifies relational database
discrepancies.design_requirement: Relational database for better query flexibility and high read speeds
discrepancies.impact: Data model may not support complex queries; migration will be required
discrepancies.recommendation: Replace MongoDB with PostgreSQL or MySQL and update all data access layers

discrepancies.title: Using HTTP Basic Auth instead of OAuth2/OIDC
discrepancies.description: Implementation uses HTTP Basic authentication instead of OAuth2 with PKCE
discrepancies.design_requirement: Authorization Code Flow with PKCE for single page applications
discrepancies.impact: Security model doesn't support modern authentication flows; vulnerable to attacks
discrepancies.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 resource server with Auth0 and PKCE flow

discrepancies.title: Missing CI/CD Variables Section
discrepancies.description: GitLab CI pipeline missing variables section for sensitive data
discrepancies.design_requirement: Variables section (lines 3-8) for usernames, passwords, etc.
discrepancies.impact: Sensitive information may be hardcoded; security risk
discrepancies.recommendation: Add variables section with GitLab CI variables for sensitive data

discrepancies.title: Missing Docker Hub Integration
discrepancies.description: No Docker Hub login or image push configured in pipeline
discrepancies.design_requirement: Docker Hub integration for image storage and distribution
discrepancies.impact: Cannot store or distribute container images
discrepancies.recommendation: Add Docker Hub login and image push commands in package stage
